facts.fact: Chiara 引见 Anneliese：丹麦人、伦敦出版业、trilingual、想在澳洲做出版；刚结束澳洲假期，有「Outback 农场修篱笆」的 amazing tale；她自述曾在 Copenhagen/Rome/London 做出版、resourceful、highly independent、爱老式电车。
facts.anchor: She’s originally from Denmark and works in publishing in London.

facts.fact: Anneliese 的澳洲判词：海滩与城市都爱，但一进 Outback 就 weird、psycho-creepy；叙述者自认「weird in some ways, lovable in others」；「想让我解释澳洲？That would be impossible: I can't even explain it to myself. I only live there」；一月抵墨尔本、与瑞典闺蜜 Carina 计划沿 Highway 1 绕全澳——后来发现 crazy idea（澳洲 mind-bogglingly large）；澳网看了四天。
facts.anchor: then the place becomes weird, kinda psycho-creepy, if you don’t mind me saying.

facts.fact: 澳网：unbelievably hot、weirdly uncanny、人多却 desolate；铁路桥上「existentially lonely」——「澳洲有种说不上来的孤独」；叙述者荐本馆藏书 The Great Australian Loneliness；Carina 父母 80/90 年代看 Borg/Edberg/Wilander 是 rite of passage、他们搭便车环澳、却让女儿看 Wolf Creek 后承诺只能租车/巴士/火车；Sydney/Bondi 晒成 brown as berries；澳无快车＝「Indifference, complacency」；Cairns 斯堪的纳维亚人多、雷暴三十分钟衣湿又晒干；青旅法国女孩抱怨塑料包装奶酪；Port Douglas→Daintree。
facts.anchor: felt existentially lonely in a way I never do back home in Copenhagen

facts.fact: Cape Tribulation 之名的来历：英国探险家的「提名复仇」（Mount Disappointment/Misery Creek/Misfortune Bay）；法国人以人名命名（D'Entrecasteaux）；南大陆旧称 Terre Napoléon（Napoleon Land）——拿破仑没来过，是他委托的 Baudin 远征；鳄鱼偏爱德国游客（'Achtung' 牌）：导游故事一——德国青年每天下午两点河边洗碗，鳄鱼靠太阳位置学会计时，第三次跃出 propulsive force 把人 head first 吃掉；故事二——三德国人夜营，鳄鱼拖人出帐篷、拔河救回一条腿、人仍 bled to death；笑话收尾：美国游客问「Cook 三次航行中哪一次死的？」
facts.anchor: Nominative revenge enacted by the early British explorers

facts.fact: Perth 三周（Carina 姑妈家、端盘子）；结识德国背包客 Gretchen the Wretched（daredevil、想独自搭便车过 Nullarbor 被劝阻）；Scarborough/Cottesloe 海滩钓到金发冲浪男孩——好看但很蠢、上床后一周就想甩（burden）；抽签定谁陪最帅者（她赢，cat with all the cream）；男孩们端盘子时来烦；Perth idyllic though middle of nowhere；叙述者：Perth 是世界最孤立的主城；她：hanging by a thread、随时滑进印度洋、建在沙上（属实）；20 刀自助餐厅＝desperate hunter-gatherer ritual、男孩总想喂胖三个只吃水果的瘦女孩； Perth 海滩 mind-blowing、常无人。
facts.anchor: We all wanted to sleep with the most handsome of the boys, so we drew lots to decide and I was the winner

facts.fact: 「澳洲的人都在哪儿？」——欧洲 jam-packed/suffocating（隔墙听见呼吸喊笑）vs 澳洲空旷如月面；叙述者共鸣：Land 是 alien/threatening 的，但对原住民「the Land is full of stories——每座山每条河都是关于起源、祖先与形而上的故事，elaborate and rich system of thought，Indigenous Australians are rooted to the Land」；旗上 Union Jack＝subservience 的标志；自嘲 digress——I blame sleeplessness。
facts.anchor: and the Outback seems like the surface of the moon

facts.fact: Nullarbor 前奏：甩掉 neanderthal 男孩（只会 pawing for sex；courtship＝酒馆看板球聊 footy/gambling/cars、thick-as-a-brick、不读报不看新闻、连总理总统都叫不出——但 contented：sun-tanned happy-go-lucky amnesia）；Gretchen 想搭便车被拒、改租 Holden Statesman（pretentious name、十五年车龄但 powerful；Indian Pacific 太贵）；租车经理：往东开避落日；当心 ferals——roo shooter 危险、专好 young blonde girls、在 Eyre Highway 沿途加油站蹲 Scandi 游客；Nullarbor＝拉丁语 nullus arbor「无树」。
facts.anchor: we had to be wary of feral guys, such as roo shooters, who could be very dangerous

facts.fact: 公路惊魂：Eyre Highway 数日、Gretchen 主驾爱开、低矮 scrub 荒凉、黑皮衣 BMW 骑士成「constant companion」（超越又被反超）、柏油热浪 shimmering、Ninety Mile Straight（世界最长直线）、日日 35 度以上；叙述者补史：曾为 Perth 女友一年三四次跨 Nullarbor（飞机/汽车/火车）；朋友两台 panel van 车队追尾（被单调催眠）、路边弃车（拖车太贵）；两车停在路边——盖布的尸体露出靴子——正是那辆 BMW，「Our regular road companion was no more」；车速减半；加油站 eerie 如恐怖片布景、40 度、只买得起 20 刀油；Ned（粗壮凶相、Land Rover 顶着高功率灯）借 20 刀给 Gretchen（她收下，Anneliese 拒）；活儿：Dave 农夫 quad bike 翻车断腿、篱笆被暴风吹倒怕牲口走失——每周 500 刀×两周＋食宿啤酒，「Think of it as a paid Outback holiday adventure」；Anneliese/Carina 判定 trap 说 No——Gretchen 已答应且握着车钥匙（不跟就被丢在加油站）；车内对骂（crazy bitch / raped and tortured – or tortured and raped / 没看过 Wolf Creek?）——Gretchen：I've made a decision...just trust my instincts；roll the dice 是人生本义、故事 ninety per cent true；跟车 15 分钟＋车道 5 分钟；她自称 Hamburg 学过 jujitsu——Anneliese 笑：jujitsu probably wouldn't be enough …；中场买酒（Copenhagen＝self-contained 如 Melbourne、unpretentious modest）；回来后 Anneliese 被 Chiara 拽去 patio 烟民区——故事 part two 悬置。
facts.anchor: Our regular road companion was no more.
